elevation.$description: STANDARDIZED 2026-10-21 on the stock Tailwind v3 box-shadow scale (shadow-sm, shadow, shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-xl, shadow-2xl) — same offsets, blurs, spreads and alphas as Tailwind's own defaults, with one deliberate change: the shadow color is the slate rgb(16 24 40), already a token (extended.dark-slate), instead of pure black, so shadows read cool against Tahche's blue-tinted neutrals. The Figma v2 file's Drop shadow/* effect styles were rewritten to match on the same date (they had drifted, including layers with negative y offsets that cast shadows upward). The Tailwind preset also defines Tailwind's own keys (sm, DEFAULT, md, lg, xl, 2xl) from these tokens, so stock shadow-md and shadow-medium render identically. Real-usage audit (2026-07-23): in every app, developers reach for Tailwind's stock shadow classes alongside — sometimes more than — the named tokens; the aliasing above closes that gap without a lint rule.

xsmall.$description: Tailwind v3 `shadow-sm`. Subtle separation between adjacent surfaces — Input Field/Box (removed entirely when Disabled), Button Group, cards against a page background. The most-used named shadow in the apps.

focus-ring.$description: REPLACED (2026-07-25), by real code evidence over the earlier Figma-sourced value: a 2026-07-25 audit of all 5 apps found the previous #E1E1FE solid 4px ring has ZERO real usage anywhere in any codebase (`grep -rni E1E1FE` across all 5 apps' src/ returns nothing). Meanwhile a translucent primary-500-at-12%-alpha, 3px, no-blur ring (`rgba(53,61,215,0.12)`) is a real, repeated, consistent implementation across 2 live apps (recruitment-portal: 4 files: TagInput, SalaryRangeSection, PillSelect, JobGeneratedContent; client-web: 3 identical instances sharing the same Jobs feature code) plus a near-variant in career-web's LoginForm (same shape/alpha/spread, indigo-600 instead of primary-500 — likely pre-tokenization drift, not a separate intentional pattern). Per this repo's own strategy (code over Figma — Figma gets updated to match code, not the reverse), this real, cross-app pattern replaces the never-shipped Figma value as the canonical token. Not every input actually uses a ring at all — a plain border-color-only focus swap (no box-shadow) is actually the single most-repeated focus treatment by file count (recruitment-portal's entire shared Form component library, 14 files) — that lighter-weight treatment remains valid too, this token is for where a ring specifically is warranted.

small.$description: Tailwind v3 `shadow` (bare). Stat cards, small raised surfaces.

large.$description: Tailwind v3 `shadow-lg`. Tooltips and floating panels.

xxlarge.$description: Tailwind v3 `shadow-2xl`. The single heaviest overlay in a view; dead as a named class in every app audited, kept for scale completeness.
